decisions.reason: The required Ferry card label wraps pressure-gauge as pressure-gau / ge drift even though the existing hyphen gives a natural break and each segment fits. This contradicts the approved natural wrapping question and the brief preference for spaces/hyphens before character fallback. Every character remains visible; this is unnatural wrapping, not truncation. In expanded state the dossier also wraps Maintenance-held as Maintenance-h / eld alerts.

Read the entire original overlapping full-content sweep: heading, notice, disclosure, card labels/severities/reasons, inline dossier when expanded, summary, action and footer occupy separate areas. No unintended overlap or occlusion is visible; viewport-edge cropping is continued in adjacent indexed frames.
